description: Headless CLI parity with the browser engine: lowercase-normalised response headers (fixes case-sensitive Content-Type lookup that suppressed link extraction and CDX MIME), browser-identical URL canonicalisation that keeps and scrubs query strings, deque plus pending-set frontier, a stdlib-only cli/politeness.py port (token bucket, decorrelated full jitter, EWMA with median warm-up, circuit breaker, capped Retry-After, interruptible sleeps) wired into aegis_cli.py with a 3-retry budget, and unittest coverage using an ephemeral loopback http.server fixture.
